spans.s:
(ऋ) चेलृ r. 1st cl. (चेलति)
1 To shake or tremble.
2 To go or move.

mfn. sub. (-लः-ली-लं)
Cloth, clothes, raiment.
adj.
Vile, wicked, bad.
E.
चिल to wear, affix अग्; also चेलक and चैल.

r. 1st cl. (चेल्लति)
1 To think.
2 To go: this root is not usually admitted: see चेल.

m. (-कः)
A washerman.
E.
चेल, and प्रक्षालक who washes.

f. (-का)
A corset, a boddice.
E.
चेल clothes, कन् aff.

m. (-मः)
A small kind of fish.
